name: Lily Tang
role: The takeaway's front and its books

temperament.from: chosen by the data-build wave 2 job from the person's card

lines.note: own lines live in lines/ (a record each); see lines/README.md

card.who: She and her husband Peter keep the Golden River takeaway and live over it. She takes the orders at the hatch.
card.speak: Bright, quick, teasing. Remembers every order.
card.life: Does the washing at the Washeteria in the morning and the orders at night. Knows who orders for one now who used to order for two.
card.fire: She remembers the smell more than the sight.
card.rivals: She keeps the rent book and knows what Agar's clerk is like on the doorstep.
